title: Spacetime-volume noise as an everpresent vacuum scale

source_evidence.locator: Sec.II Eqs.(1)-(2); Sec.III Eqs.(3)-(6); Sec.IV conservation discussion

assumptions: Poisson number-to-four-volume correspondence, Lambda-volume conjugacy, and assumed zero mean; these do not derive a full quantum dynamics.
Flat homogeneous expanding universe; separately conserved matter/radiation with a stochastic term retained in the Friedmann constraint while the other Einstein evolution equation is dropped.
Past-light-cone volume and independent random increments are phenomenological choices.
The foundation sets the reduced Planck mass to one (8piG=1); its alpha in density Eq.(5) must not be numerically identified with the later geometric-Lambda recursion containing 8pi alpha.
predictions: Order-of-density, sign-changing vacuum fluctuations can occur through cosmic epochs, rather than a constant vacuum term.
Realizations reaching negative total density are not given complete dynamics; survival and selection affect predicted histories.

The early-time BBN, CMB and structure statements are test proposals, with no completed perturbation or observational calculation in this source. The source-era claim that about half of realizations have positive Lambda today is not an independently established survival-conditioned probability.
qualification: Source proposal or reported conditional test only; no independent reproduction, observational reassessment or scientific qualification.
